have been with this practice for over 12 years, whilst it can be difficult sometimes to get an appointment, you can always turn up on the day and wait. Get there after 09:00 go to the window they will book you in and you wait until your name appears on the wall message,  again simple! When your GP either finds time between patients or at the end of the patients in the waiting room, you will receive a call back by your GP, again simple... I don't understand some of the complaints I have seen posted, Yes sometimes the staff could friendlier, but they too are human, with their own problems, and the person before you might have been one of those self centered winging buggers who turn up on the day hoping to jump in front of all those other patients who have appointments .
